privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.intro: This form collects personal information to set up your employment at Silverleaf Academy.
privacy.collected: What we collect: your identity and contact details, government ID numbers, banking details, qualifications, employment history, family and emergency contacts, and a declaration. Some questions about health or criminal history are optional.
privacy.purpose: Why we collect it: solely to manage your employment and onboarding (payroll, compliance, and emergency contact).
privacy.access: Who can see it: you, and authorised Silverleaf HR administrators. It is not shared further without a lawful basis.
privacy.security: How it is stored: securely, with access limited to those who need it for the purposes above.
privacy.retention: You may review and update this information at any time by returning to this page.

consent.heading: Consent
consent.label: I consent to Silverleaf processing this information for employment and onboarding purposes.
consent.required: You must give consent before submitting.
consent.recordedNote: Your consent is recorded with the date and a version reference.

sensitive.note: This question concerns special-category data and is optional. You may leave it blank.
sensitive.healthNote: Health information is sensitive and optional. Only share what you are comfortable providing.
sensitive.criminalNote: This concerns criminal-history information and is optional.

fields.arrestRecord: Have you ever been arrested, detained, or deported?
fields.misconductRecord: Have you ever been discharged or forced to resign for misconduct?

help.spouse: Shown for married members. Leave blank if not applicable.
help.references: Provide up to three referees who are not related to you by blood or marriage.
help.relativesEmployed: Disclose any relatives already working at Silverleaf (conflict-of-interest).

documents.title: Certificates & supporting documents
documents.help: Upload scans or photos of your certificates (PDF or image). They are stored privately and visible only to you and Silverleaf HR.
documents.accept: Accepted: PDF, PNG, JPG, GIF, WEBP, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX. Maximum 25 MB per file.
documents.saveFirst: Save your details once (above) to start attaching certificates.

errors.tooLarge: That file is larger than 25 MB.
errors.unsupportedType: That file type isn't allowed. Use a PDF, an image, or an Office document.
errors.profileRequired: Please save your profile once before uploading certificates.
errors.failed: The upload failed. Please try again.
